summary: Main backend engineer on a cloud-based, multi-tenant SaaS for real-time quality-control inspections across factories, product lots, and distribution points.
highlights: Owned backend architecture and delivery for the multi-tenant inspection platform end to end.

Took over the client relationship mid-project after the PM left: diagnosed a roadmap built on misread requirements, brought the team's lead frontend engineer and lead QA into the client meetings, proposed a reorganized roadmap, renegotiated scope and deadlines with a frustrated client, and rebuilt trust over a few sprints of working software — the recovered account won the company further work.
Onboarded and mentored new team members on the business domain and technical stack.
